svg.title: Signature Authorship Engine — architecture diagram
svg.desc: Three-layer system: behavioral geometry (ASE, Pendulum, Behavior Module), signal filtering (SNR Passthrough), and identity memory (IME). Feeds into a document authorship verdict.

sendPrompt('What does the resonance-field plugin do?')
sendPrompt('What does the SNR gate plugin do?')
sendPrompt('What other plugins are in SNR?')
sendPrompt('How does IME build a trust profile over time?')
sendPrompt('What output does the authorship engine produce?')
g.text: signature match · trust score · anomaly flags → embedded in document
